data.one_liner: Singleton isolated worker for running heavy tasks in isolates on Flutter and web workers on web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a singleton isolated worker that runs heavy computational tasks in a separate Isolate on mobile/desktop platforms and via Web Workers on the web. It mimics Flutter's compute function syntax and includes a WorkerDelegator to handle shared platform execution.
use_when: You need to run heavy background calculations without blocking the main UI thread.
You need a cross-platform solution that supports both Dart Isolates and Web Workers with a similar API.
avoid_when: You only need simple one-off background tasks where Flutter's built-in compute function is sufficient.
You are working entirely on platforms where standard Dart isolates or Isolate.run already satisfy all your background processing requirements.
strengths: Identical syntax to Flutter's compute function.
Cross-platform support including web via Web Workers.
WorkerDelegator simplifies sharing execution logic across platforms.
weaknesses: Web workers require manual setup of a worker.js file in the web folder.
Web worker execution cannot directly use Dart closures as messages due to web platform limitations.
data.setup_notes: For web support, you must download a worker.js file and place it in the web directory of your Flutter project.
